items.title: The Limits of Long-Context Reasoning in Automated Bug Fixing
items.title_zh: 自动化缺陷修复中长上下文推理的局限
items.summary: Systematically evaluates long-context code debugging and patch generation on SWE-bench Verified, finding that agentic trajectories succeed mainly through decomposition into short steps: successful runs typically stay under 20k-30k tokens and longer accumulated contexts correlate with lower success. With relevant files placed in a 64k-token context and perfect retrieval recall, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B resolves only 7% and GPT-5-nano none, revealing a gap between nominal and usable context capacity.

items.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
items.title_zh: GLM-5：从氛围编程走向智能体工程
items.summary: GLM-5 is a next-generation foundation model aimed at moving from vibe coding to agentic engineering, using DSA to cut training and inference costs while preserving long-context fidelity. It adds asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure and asynchronous agent RL algorithms, reports state-of-the-art results on major open benchmarks and releases code and models.

items.title: MedProbCLIP: Probabilistic Adaptation of Vision-Language Foundation Model for Reliable Radiograph-Report Retrieval
items.title_zh: MedProbCLIP：面向可靠影像-报告检索的视觉语言基础模型概率化适配
items.summary: MedProbCLIP models chest X-ray and radiology-report representations as Gaussian embeddings through a probabilistic contrastive objective, adding a variational information bottleneck and multi-view, multi-section encodings during training. On MIMIC-CXR it outperforms CLIP, CXR-CLIP and PCME++ in retrieval and zero-shot classification, with better calibration and robustness to clinically relevant corruptions.

items.title: Updating Parametric Knowledge with Context Distillation Retains Post-Training Capabilities
items.title_zh: 用上下文蒸馏更新参数知识可保留后训练能力
items.summary: Introduces Distillation via Split Contexts (DiSC), which conditions student and teacher distributions on distinct segments of a training example and minimizes KL divergence between their shared tokens. Across four post-trained models it reports the best trade-off between learning new knowledge and retaining instruction-following, reasoning and factual knowledge.

items.title: CARL-CXR: Continual Adapter-Based Routing for Task-Unknown Chest Radiograph Classification
items.title_zh: CARL-CXR：面向任务未知胸片分类的持续适配器路由
items.summary: CARL-CXR keeps a fixed high-capacity backbone while incrementally adding lightweight task-specific adapters and classifier heads, using a latent task selector, task prototypes and feature-level experience replay to route inputs without storing images. On MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert it limits catastrophic forgetting to a 0.012 AUROC drop, a 6x and 11x reduction over LwF and EWC, and reaches 75.0% routing accuracy under task-unknown deployment versus 62.5% for joint training.

items.title: Enhancing Building Semantics Preservation in AI Model Training with Large Language Model Encodings
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型编码增强 AI 模型训练中的建筑语义保持
items.summary: The study uses OpenAI GPT and Meta LLaMA embeddings, including 1,024-dimensional Matryoshka-compacted versions, as encodings for training GraphSAGE models to classify 42 building object subtypes across five high-rise residential BIMs. LLM encodings beat one-hot baselines, with the compacted llama-3 embedding reaching a weighted average F1 of 0.8766 versus 0.8475.

items.title: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Reasoning Approaches for Error Detection in Solidity Smart Contracts
items.title_zh: Solidity 智能合约错误检测的零样本推理方法基准
items.summary: Evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs on a balanced dataset of 400 Solidity contracts for binary error detection and vulnerability classification under zero-shot, zero-shot chain-of-thought and tree-of-thought prompting. CoT and ToT raise detection recall to roughly 95-99% but usually reduce precision, while Claude 3 Opus reaches the best weighted F1 of 90.8 under ToT for classification.

items.title: Decision Quality Evaluation Framework at Pinterest
items.title_zh: Pinterest 的决策质量评估框架
items.summary: Describes a decision quality evaluation framework deployed at Pinterest, centered on a subject-matter-expert-curated Golden Set and an automated propensity-score sampling pipeline that expands dataset coverage. The framework is used to benchmark LLM agent cost-performance, guide data-driven prompt optimization, manage policy evolution and continuously validate prevalence metrics.

items.title: Evidence-Grounded Subspecialty Reasoning: Evaluating a Curated Clinical Intelligence Layer on the 2025 Endocrinology Board-Style Examination
items.title_zh: 基于证据的亚专科推理：在 2025 年内分泌学委员会考试上评估精选临床智能层
items.summary: Evaluates January Mirror, an evidence-grounded clinical reasoning system that combines a curated endocrinology and cardiometabolic corpus with a structured reasoning architecture under a closed-evidence constraint, on a 120-question board-style exam. Mirror scores 87.5% versus 62.3% for the human reference and 74.6% for GPT-5.2, and 74.2% of its outputs cite at least one guideline-tier source with 100% citation accuracy on manual verification.

items.title: microsoft/Ontology-Playground
items.title_zh: microsoft/Ontology-Playground——学习本体与 Microsoft Fabric IQ 的开源工具
items.summary: A free, open-source, fully static web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ that lets users browse pre-built ontologies, design their own visually, export RDF/XML and share interactive diagrams.

items.title: Beyond Full-Text Extraction: Why Page-Level Granularity Matters
items.title_zh: 超越全文抽取：为何页面级粒度很重要
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product post argues that page-level granularity matters when extracting content beyond full-text pipelines.
